tool_schemas.name: get-alerts
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current weather alerts for the provided two-letter state code, serving a cached result when it is still fresh and otherwise fetching, normalizing, storing, and returning the latest alerts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if state is not exactly 2 characters, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds quota/rate limits; raises NOT_FOUND when the upstream has no alert feed for the given state code.

tool_schemas.name: get-forecast
tool_schemas.description: Returns the point forecast for the given latitude/longitude, serving a cached forecast when fresh and otherwise fetching, normalizing, storing, and returning the latest forecast. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if latitude is outside [-90, 90] or longitude is outside [-180, 180], UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds quota/rate limits; raises NOT_FOUND when the coordinates cannot be resolved to a forecastable point by the upstream provider.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the presented API key, including resolved api_key_id, workspace_name, allowed scopes, key status, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and KEY_INACTIVE when the key is suspended or revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent the same way as other endpoints).

tool_schemas.name: list-api-keys
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys visible to the caller with optional filtering by status and workspace name, returning paginated results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to view API keys.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: create-api-key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key with limits and initial status, returning the created api_keys record and the plaintext key value once. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to create keys; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid limits or fields.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.

workspace_name.description: Workspace name associated with the key.

status.description: Initial status for the key (revoked cannot be created).

tool_schemas.name: update-api-key
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an API key, including lifecycle transitions for status (active↔suspended, active/suspended→revoked). Returns the updated api_keys record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted; refuses KEY_INACTIVE if the caller key is suspended/revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.

id.description: Primary key of the api_keys record to update.

requests_per_minute_limit.description: New sliding-window requests per minute limit.

requests_per_day_limit.description: New UTC-day requests per day limit.

status.description: New status. Allowed transitions: active→suspended/revoked, suspended→active/revoked; revoked is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: list-api-requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists logged API requests for the workspace with filtering by tool, time window, response status, and api_key_id, returning paginated results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to view logs.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.

api_key_id.description: Filter by the API key id that made the request.

served_from_cache.description: Filter by whether the response was served from cache.

response_status_code.description: Filter by HTTP-like response status code.

created_at_gte.description: Return requests created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_lte.description: Return requests created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: list-cache-snapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached snapshots for alerts or forecasts with filtering by key fields and status, returning paginated results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to view cached data.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.

state.description: For alerts snapshots, filter by two-letter state code.

latitude.description: For forecast snapshots, filter by latitude.

longitude.description: For forecast snapshots, filter by longitude.

geohash7.description: For forecast snapshots, filter by 7-character geohash.

expires_before.description: Return snapshots expiring before this timestamp.

fetched_after.description: Return snapshots fetched after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

metadata.name: Weather
